description: This file implements a React component and helpers for displaying toast notifications (user feedback messages) in a web UI. It includes functions to enqueue messages of different levels (success, info, error), manages toast lifecycle with automatic dismissal after 3 seconds, and renders a toast container component.

methods.name: randomId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string for each toast message.

methods.name: ToastItem
methods.description: React component for rendering individual toast messages with auto-dismiss behavior.

methods.name: ToastHost
methods.description: React component that manages the collection of active toasts and renders them within a portal.
